description: This file contains functions related to installing, upgrading, and configuring system email templates in SuiteCRM, including retrieving email template data and setting default configurations.

methods.name: installSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Installs system email templates by creating new email template beans and saving their IDs in configuration.

methods.name: upgradeSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Calls the installation function to upgrade system email templates.

methods.name: setSystemEmailTemplatesDefaultConfig
methods.description: Sets default configuration for system email templates, specifically the confirm opt-in template ID.

methods.name: getSystemEmailTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined system email templates, including a confirm opt-in email template.
